title: Corrected Refiling Charge — Filings Unit Charge Rule (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Charge rule

A corrected refiling answers a state rejection of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate with corrected information from the customer when the rejection code is one the customer must correct, and Cardinal corrects and refiles on its own when the code is one Cardinal corrects. A corrected refiling is charged the correction rate, which is the certificate's refiling fee after rejection as scheduled for the certificate held, and the corrected refiling charge is that rate booked to the cent.

The corrected refiling charge is the correction charge plus the corrected-refiling delivery charge and the corrected-refiling handling charge, the sum rounded to the cent, and it is booked once, on the corrected refiling transmission, at 0.00 where the sum is zero.

## Amounts entering the charge

| Amount | Value |
|---|---|
| Correction rate | The certificate's refiling fee after rejection |
| Correction charge | The correction rate as it stands |
| Corrected-refiling delivery charge | 0.00 |
| Corrected-refiling handling charge | 0.00 |
| Corrected refiling charge | Correction charge, delivery charge and handling charge added together, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

1. A certificate whose refiling fee after rejection is 0.00: correction rate 0.00, correction charge 0.00, delivery 0.00, handling 0.00 — corrected refiling charge **0.00**, still booked, at 0.00, on the corrected refiling transmission.
2. For illustration only, a refiling fee after rejection of 6.50 would give a corrected refiling charge of 6.50.

The rounding to the cent is applied to the sum, once.
